subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should this PR remain blocked until real embedded-agent proof demonstrates both the internal-handoff drop path and the `sessions_send` preservation path?
rationale: This is an external PR changing session-state prompt semantics; focused helper tests and green CI do not prove the real embedded-agent drop/preserve behavior or settle the competing repair strategy.

options.title: Require real embedded-runner proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, runtime logs, or a recording from a patched embedded-agent run showing internal stale text is dropped and `sessions_send` text is preserved.

options.title: Accept maintainer-held equivalent proof
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers already have private runtime evidence and explicitly accept the six-source predicate scope.

options.title: Pause for semantic consolidation
options.body: Coordinate this branch with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 and choose one canonical repair strategy before more contributor work.

recommendation.title: Require real embedded-runner proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, runtime logs, or a recording from a patched embedded-agent run showing internal stale text is dropped and `sessions_send` text is preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced by the merged preservation work.
